ms.tip.both.4: If you cannot see glowing targets, you can appropriately increase the "Entity Distance" setting
ms.tip.both.5: Once an aura mechanic is triggered, it will not become invalid even if its trigger conditions are no longer met later
ms.tip.both.6: If you want to experience the era without the charging state, maybe you can try version 1.0
ms.tip.both.7: Feel free to share any questions or ideas with the dev team! Contact info is on the notice board
ms.tip.both.8: Heart Fire Project is recruiting: Builders / Modelers / Artists / Programmers. Contact the dev team for details
ms.tip.guar.1: Don't camp dying souls, it's completely useless
ms.tip.guar.2: Although you cannot hold a relic, this doesn't stop you from opening a soul treasure chest
ms.tip.guar.3: The amount of shards is always slightly more than needed; don't camp the shards
ms.tip.guar.4: As a guardian, your aura detection bar will never turn red, no matter how close you are
ms.tip.guar.5: As long as your weapon hits something, regardless of whether it deals damage, you will enter the whiffing state
ms.tip.guar.6: If your weapon has an enchantment glint, you can deal double damage then
ms.tip.soul.1: It's probably not just your teammates who are rushing to the soul light...
ms.tip.soul.2: Opening a soul treasure chest while holding a relic will recover health and make the guardian glow
ms.tip.soul.3: You can also collect shards during the charging state, which will extend the countdown of the state
ms.tip.soul.4: When a soul light is lit, the dying soul with the shortest remaining time will be prioritized as the healing target
ms.tip.soul.5: If there is only one soul left on the field, the game will provide them with some help
ms.tip.soul.6: Even if no health is lost, you will still gain invincibility and a movement speed boost after being hit
ms.title: ◈ Midnight Soul ◈
ms.tooltip.curse.detail: When a soul passes by, makes them glow and -15%% M.SPD; after opening, makes them glow for 3s and -30%% M.SPD for 7s. When a guardian passes by, makes the closest soul glow; after opening, makes all souls glow for 3s and +40%% M.SPD for 15s
ms.tutorial.0-1.desc: As a soul, your goal is to collect scattered shards, open the portal, and successfully revive.
ms.tutorial.0-1.sub: Welcome, lost soul. Stay away from the red-glowing enemies and get ready to start to collect shards
ms.tutorial.0-2.desc: As a soul guardian, your goal is simple: slaughter all the souls.
ms.tutorial.0-2.sub: Welcome to your first guarding duty... Take your weapon and sever all the souls!
ms.tutorial.0-3.desc: As a spectator, press 1~9 to conveniently spectate players. Try not to give away their positions.
ms.tutorial.0-3.sub: As a spectator, you can press 1~9 to teleport to the corresponding player. It is advised not to give away their positions...
ms.tutorial.1-1.desc: Continuously interact with soul shards to collect them. Filling the gauge will make the portal emerge.
ms.tutorial.1-1.sub.g: These low-floating objects are soul shards. Souls need to collect them to proceed to the next step
ms.tutorial.1-1.sub.s: These floating objects in the air are soul shards. You must collect them to proceed to the next step
ms.tutorial.1-2.desc: The soul light will glow. By continuously interacting with it, you can lit it to heal the soul with the shortest remaining time in dying state.
ms.tutorial.1-2.sub.g: The soul light can recover the soul you just struck down. Please pay close attention and maintain proper defense
ms.tutorial.1-2.sub.s: The soul light can save you or your teammates; make sure it is safe, and hurry to lit it
ms.tutorial.1-3.desc: The soul treasure chest will refresh periodically. By continuously interacting with it, you can open it. When a soul opens it, they can acquire a relic; holding a relic will make the guardian glow and restore health. The guardian cannot acquire a relic, but can gain movement speed and make the souls glow.
ms.tutorial.1-3.sub.g: You cannot acquire the relics from the soul treasure chests, but you can still open them to obtain effects.
ms.tutorial.1-3.sub.s: Opening the soul treasure chest grants various items, but you can only hold one at a time
ms.tutorial.1-4.desc: The portal usually glows. It can be charged by multiple people simultaneously and stores its progress. Interact with it to charge it; once fully charged, the portal will activate to revive the souls.
ms.tutorial.1-4.sub.g: It takes a long time to activate the portal. Make good use of this opportunity, there is not much time left...
ms.tutorial.1-4.sub.s: The portal requires a long time to activate, but the progress can be accumulated... Beware of the empowered guardian!
ms.tutorial.2-1.desc: Generally, taking an attack from the soul guardian will cost you half your health. Take advantage of the speed boost and invincibility time after being hit; you'd better run as far as you can and avoid getting caught a second time.
ms.tutorial.2-1.sub: Unless there is a damage bonus, you should have already lost half your health... Run fast while you still have the speed boost and invincibility!
ms.tutorial.2-2.desc: As long as your attack hits the target, regardless of whether it deals damage, you will enter a 7-second whiffing state.
ms.tutorial.2-2.sub: As long as you hit the target, regardless of whether it deals damage, you will enter the whiffing state...
ms.tutorial.2-3.desc: Every time your health is depleted, you will enter the dying state and start a countdown; if you do not recover from the dying state before the countdown ends, you will perish. The countdown will be shortened for multi dying times.
ms.tutorial.2-3.sub: After being knocked down, your teammates can save you within a limited time, otherwise you will perish...
ms.tutorial.2-4.desc: After the portal appears, the guardian will be empowered, increasing its damage and movement speed; after it activates, all souls will glow and gain increased movement speed, while the guardian's movement speed increases again. Upon entering the portal, the souls can be revived.
ms.tutorial.2-4.sub.g: Your movement speed and damage have already significantly increased; after the portal activates, your movement speed will further increase
ms.tutorial.2-4.sub.s: After the portal activates, your movement speed is slightly increased, but you will also glow... Hurry to the portal and revive
ms.tutorial.2-5.desc: When recovering from the dying state, you will be teleported to the lit soul light, and gain increased movement speed and invincibility for a certain period. The invincibility duration is shorter than the speed boost.
ms.tutorial.2-5.sub: After recovering from the dying state, you will gain increased movement speed and invincibility... perhaps you can take a hit for your savior?
ms.tutorial.3-1.desc: Aura detection is a warning mechanic in the game. When both sides are close to each other, the top gauge will change color. Both the guardian and the souls can trigger the yellow bar, but only the souls will trigger the red bar.
ms.tutorial.3-1.sub: The color of the top gauge has changed! This indicates that there are enemies nearby. Let the chase begin!
ms.tutorial.3-2.desc: Relics and fully cooled-down skills can be cast by pressing [%s], while talents trigger automatically. Exceptions will be specified in the item description.
ms.tutorial.3-2.sub: You have a castable ability. Select it and press [%s] to cast it!
ms.tutorial.3-3.desc: The aura mechanic triggers based on the collection progress or the game situation; the current aura level is reflected on the gauge. The former helps players find the remaining shards, while the latter advances the game.
ms.tutorial.3-3.sub: The aura mechanic will indicate the locations of the remaining shards, and it might also advance the game more directly...
ms.tutorial.3-4.desc: Echo is a global random effect that may change certain mechanics or even the overall gameplay. Echo will not trigger if there are inexperienced players in the current match.
ms.tutorial.3-4.sub: Echo can greatly change the game. Formulate strategies and make good use of it!
ms.tutorial.first_enter: Welcome to Midnight Soul! Press [%s] to check the tutorial tab for your first step......
ms.weapon.0.desc: Sever the impure with a sharp blade
ms.weapon.1.desc: Sever the impure with a radiant blade
ms.weapon.2.desc: Sever the impure with a battle-tested blade
ms.weapon.3.desc: A single strike to pierce the skull!
ms.weapon.4.desc: Feels burning hot in hand... keep it away from water!
ms.weapon.desc: Advanced weapons can provide up to a 0.00%% bonus
